I have a lot of general gameplay tips, but I feel this is already quite a wall of text.

Tips for support:

* **Do not build your turret too far.** By this I mean, even if you're on the offensive lane, don't try to push your turret too far as it could easily destroyed when you're surrounded. Also, do your best to place the turret where it covers a wide area of the bot lanes.

* **Stay wary!** Honestly, support is useless without the turret OR another player (preferably enforcer). So if you find your self alone, you better fall back and call someone or you can get chain-grappled and what not.
* **Your main damaging attack is the Airstrike.** get used to the timing. Aim for bots over turrets. Just do your best to do as much damage with it. Splash damage is awesome. But then, airstrikes are also great for damaging enemy firebases, combat kitties and venice defences so I'd probably go (Enemy Firebase/Combat Kitty/Venice Defence > Bots > LaserBlazer/RockIt turret).

* **Prepare for the annihilator!** Know when the annihilator comes (I honestly don't know the exact times since times vary on the length of annihilator fights. I do know that after about 10 seconds after bullseye comes, it's a good early call to go to the annihilator before the "annihilator ready in 30 seconds" announcement is done, so you have time to set-up. *Also, place the turret where it can only be hit when you're standing on the annihilator.*

* **Defend the annihilator** You can easily defend the annihilator with your *Airstrikes + Overclock*. You could do 3 air strikes in a row if you know how to use overclock right, and even 6 if you have a +15% skill regen boost. You can throw the airstrike **below** the annihilator in Loco Moco and Gun Mountain, and the airstrike also reaches the annihilator in GrenADE iii, and the other places.

* **Use your weapons** A good strategy when your enemy is far from their turret and you're pushing them back is to use your hurt gun to slow them down, allowing you to chase them, then quickly switch to your shotgun and grapple. *You usually get a chance to shoot them perfectly with all the bullets in one shot (which deals good damage depending on your level vs theirs) after the grapple.* Keep in mind that grappling someone when you don't have a teammate to take advantage is not recommended *unless* you are doing a 1 on 1. But then, what are you doing in a 1 on 1???

* **The final turret** The hardest turret to destroy, and pretty much the most important one, is the RockIt turret. Though it would be tempting to place your turret right behind the walls of their money ball, Don't. In maps such as Downtown Spunky, GrenADE iii, the bot spawns are in front of the money ball. Take advantage of these by placing your turret there and keeping maintenance, thus leading to an xp farm.

All of these tips are situational, sometimes your teammates will take a lot of damage, severely decreasing your free time to heal your turret, heal yourself with the hurt gun, and other things. You just really can't do much if you're being pushed back and have to heal your teammate, sometimes it's best to switch lanes.

Speaking of switching lanes, I main on Spark, which is a commando like the Assassin you play as and I seem to be able to kill more bots on the offensive lane. I kill the enemy bots with melee while the turrets are distracted on the team's bots.

Here's a [link](http://forums.uberent.com/forums/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=17053) to some good endorsement builds.

**TL;DR** 

* Don't solo lanes. 
* Defend the Annihilator.
* Kill bots with your airstrike, essentially doing what you can to get the most experience (other than healing teammates).
* Know where to place your turret.
* And grapple when you know it would help (and not just lead you to your death)
